instruction: The shared helper that strips non-alphanumeric characters in `textutils/_helpers.py` returns the text unchanged, so `is_palindrome` fails on palindromes containing punctuation and spaces. `is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')` returns `False` instead of `True`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/_helpers.py b/textutils/_helpers.py
--- a/textutils/_helpers.py
+++ b/textutils/_helpers.py
@@ -15,4 +15,4 @@
 
 def strip_non_alnum(text: str) -> str:
     """Return ``text`` with every non-alphanumeric character removed."""
-    return text
+    return "".join(ch for ch in text if ch.isalnum())
